title: Sprookjesmusical: De gelaarsde Kat
description: Adds hats and other stuff like an register and a fridge
body:
**Welcome to the official page of Sprookjesmusical: De gelaarsde Kat!**

 _Sprookjesmusical: De gelaarsde Kat_ runs on [Forge 1.20.1](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/index_1.20.1.html) and was **made for an musical recreation.**

 
**WARNING THIS MOD IS IN DUTCH NOT IN ENGLISH!!!!!**

## This mod adds:

- Hats
- Plates
- An register
- Coffeemugs
- An coffee maker
- An fridge
- The logo of this mod
- And more! **(Check the [Changelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/sprookjesmusical-de-gelaarsde-kat/changelog) for newer info.)**
